key_decisions.rationale: Retains the passive gift, mystery, and insider–outsider contrast without adding a theory of exclusion.
key_decisions.before: He said to them, “To you has been given the mystery of the kingdom of God, but for those outside everything comes in parables,
key_decisions.after: He told them, “The mystery of God’s kingdom has been given to you. But for those outside, everything comes in parables,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And he said to them, “To you has been given the mystery of the reign of God, but for those outside, everything comes in parables,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the difficult purpose and prevention language rather than replacing it with because; repeated verbs remain audible.
key_decisions.before: so that ‘they may indeed look but not perceive, and may indeed hear but not understand, lest they turn and be forgiven.’”
key_decisions.after: so that ‘they may look and look but not see, and listen and listen but not understand, lest they turn back and be forgiven.’”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: so that ‘they may indeed look, but not perceive, and may indeed hear, but not understand, lest they turn again and be forgiven.’”

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the purposive paradox rather than reducing it to a prediction of eventual discovery.
key_decisions.before: Nothing is hidden except to be revealed, and nothing is concealed except to come into the open.
key_decisions.after: For nothing is hidden except to be revealed, and nothing is kept secret except to come into the open.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For nothing is hidden except to be made manifest, nor is anything secret except to come to light.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the comparison’s unqualified superlative instead of silently modernizing its botanical scope.
key_decisions.before: It is like a mustard seed, which when sown on the ground is among the smallest of the seeds on earth.
key_decisions.after: It is like a mustard seed. When sown in the ground, it is the smallest of all the seeds on earth.
